subject: Bullet Bag
text: In The Lost Woods, shoot the hanging target circle on the tree three times to receive the Bullet Bag from a scrub.

subject: Bullet Bag
text: The Bullet Bag upgrades the Fairy Slingshot Deku Seed capacity from 30 seeds to 40 seeds.

subject: Bunny Hood
text: After acquiring all three Spiritual Stones, return to the Happy Mask shop to borrow the Bunny Hood.

subject: Running Man
text: The man running laps around Lon Lon Ranch on Hyrule Field buys the Bunny Hood for top Rupee.

subject: Chicken
text: After receiving the Weird Egg from Malon at Hyrule Castle, wait until morning for it to hatch into a chicken.

subject: Talon
text: The hatched chicken makes enough noise to wake up Malon's dad Talon once located.

subject: Claim Check
text: Biggoron gives Link the Claim Check after receiving the World's Finest Eyedrops.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: After obtaining the Claim Check, wait a few days and return to Biggoron to receive the Biggoron's Sword.

subject: Cojiro
text: After waking up Talon with the Pocket Cucco, return it to the girl to receive the blue Cucco named Cojiro.

subject: Deku Nut Upgrade
text: In The Lost Woods, blow up the rock near the entrance to Sacred Forest Meadow with the Bomb Bag to obtain a Deku Nut carrying capacity upgrade.

subject: Kokiri Shop
text: The Deku Shield can be purchased for 40 Rupees in the Kokiri Shop right at the start of the game.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Taking a left and then another left upon entering The Lost Woods leads to a Deku Scrub among pillars who sells a Deku Stick capacity upgrade to 20 sticks.

subject: Deku Stick Upgrade
text: Dropping into a secret hole in the Lost Woods while wearing the Skull Mask from the Happy Mask Shop upgrades Deku Stick capacity to 30 sticks.

subject: Door Key
text: The Door Key is found by playing the treasure chest minigame in Hyrule Market as Young Link to unlock subsequent doors.

subject: Empty Bottle
text: Winning Talon's Super Cucco minigame at Lon Lon Ranch awards an Empty Bottle.

subject: Empty Bottle
text: In Kakariko Village during the day, helping a girl find all of her missing chickens awards an Empty Bottle.
